name: Gómez Manrique
bio: Gómez Manrique was a Castilian nobleman, soldier and poet, born about 1412 and dying about 1490. He belonged to the powerful Manrique family and took an active part in the political and military struggles of Castile in the fifteenth century.
He wrote courtly love lyrics, satires and religious and occasional verse in the Castilian cancionero tradition. He was the uncle of the poet Jorge Manrique.

poems.title: A una dama que yua cubierta
poems.author: Gómez Manrique
poems.collection: The Oxford Book of Spanish Verse (1913)
poems.text:
El coraçon se me fue
donde vuestro vulto vi,
e luego vos conosci
al punto que vos mire;
que no puedo fazer tanto
por mucho que vos cubriese
aquel vuestro negro manto
que no vos reconosciese.

Que debaxo se mostraua
vuestra gracia y gentil ayre,
y el cubrir con buen donayre
todo lo magnifestaua;
asy que con mis enojos
e muy grande turbacion
alla se fueron mis ojos
do tenia el coraçon.
